_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج سجل الدروس المستفادة هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Category.guidance: Document the category of lesson, such as process, technical, environmental, stakeholder, phase, etc.

Trigger.guidance: Describe the context, event, or condition that led to the challenge, problem, or beneficial outcome.

Lesson.guidance: Articulate the lesson that can be passed on to other projects and to the organization.

Responsible party.guidance: Identify the person who is assigned to implement any changes to ensure the lesson is communicated and distributed.

التعليقات.guidance: Document any clarifying comments about the challenge, problem, good practice, or other fields on the form.
